intro.uz: Bu — bozordagi eʼlon. Oʻqishdan oldin: sumkangizda odatda nimalar boʻladi?

paragraphs.en: LOST BAG. My name is Kamola, and I can't find my bag. I think it is at Chorsu Bazaar, near the bread stalls.
paragraphs.uz: SUMKA YOʻQOLDI. Mening ismim Kamola, men sumkamni topa olmayapman. Menimcha, u Chorsu bozorida, non rastalari yaqinida.

paragraphs.en: It is a small brown bag. There is a black phone, a blue notebook and my keys in it. There is no money in it.
paragraphs.uz: Bu — kichkina jigarrang sumka. Uning ichida qora telefon, koʻk daftar va kalitlarim bor. Ichida pul yoʻq.

paragraphs.en: The notebook is very important to me. My English homework and my poems are in it.
paragraphs.uz: Daftar men uchun juda muhim. Unda ingliz tili uy vazifam va sheʼrlarim bor.

paragraphs.en: Can you help me? My phone is in the bag, so please call my brother Jahongir. His number is below. Thank you!
paragraphs.uz: Menga yordam bera olasizmi? Telefonim sumkada, shuning uchun iltimos, akam Jahongirga qoʻngʻiroq qiling. Uning raqami pastda. Rahmat!

grammar.example: There is no money in it.
